title: Exit Attribution — MFE/MAE Analysis
hypothesis: Time-exit trades (60% of all trades) show profitable opportunities that the current exits fail to capture, vs trades that never became profitable at all.
null_hypothesis: Time-exit trades never became profitable — the entry itself was wrong.
notes: Tracks Maximum Favorable Excursion (MFE) and Maximum Adverse Excursion (MAE) per trade to determine if profitable opportunities existed but were not captured by current exit logic.
